english.note: Use this for the all-purpose expression of forceful, vigorous, or powerful action.
This is the all-purpose choice for doing something forcefully, vigorously, or powerfully.
This is the all-purpose choice for doing something with strong force or energy.
Use this when “highly” describes strongly praising, supporting, or recommending someone or something in everyday speech.
